svg.title: Attune favicon — 3d4-2r, amber on graphite
svg.desc:
Only /attune uses this. Every other page on warrenlabs.com keeps the Warren Labs W favicon (assets/brand/svg/wl-favicon_*), because Warren Labs is the speaker there.
Graphite ground, so ONE file is correct in both browser themes — the same reasoning as the app icon. A transparent-ground mark would need a light and a dark variant to stay legible.
Amber is #EE9A3A, the dark-ground amber. Do not substitute the site's --accent (#FF9E2C dark / #a85c04 light): the ground here is fixed graphite, so the colour must be fixed too.
The mark path is copied verbatim from Assets/Logo/export/README.md in the Attune repo. Scaled to the 32-unit box at 0.24 and optically centred on its INK box (the stroke, not the path), and the stroke widened to 9 in mark units so it survives a 16px favicon.
